messages:
marta_peopleops: Heads-up: a few timezone/holiday wrinkles for this review cycle we need managers to note. If you have people in APAC or LATAM, please read the scheduling guidance here: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/timezones :earth_asia:
hiro_manager: thanks. can you summarise the main action items for managers with APAC directs?
marta_peopleops: TL;DR: 1) don't assume EOD PT = EOD for them. set local-deadline field in the review form. 2) pick a calibration slot that falls within 9am-6pm local for the person being discussed, or submit asynchronous notes if not possible. 3) flag any stat holidays in the exception form so we can shift deadlines.
sophia_engineering: For async notes, is there a template? some of my skip-levels prefer bullets only.
marta_peopleops: yes 12 use the Async Review template (link in doc). Keep it 3 bullets: impact, evidence, ask (rating/provisional). We accept short voice notes too if that helps.
lee_sre: payroll/legal question: if a rating impacts compensation cycles in-country, do we need extra approvals?
marta_peopleops: Good catch. For APAC markets with local comp boards (SG, JP), please cc comp-ops@redwood and attach the calibration note. We added a checkbox in the form to trigger comp review.
hiro_manager: Calendly only had slots in our timezone; how do I find APAC-friendly slots?
calendar_bot: Calibration calendar now has multi-window mode. Use this link to filter by timezone: https://calendly.com/redwood-calibration?tz=Asia/Tokyo
sophia_engineering: If someone is on a national holiday the week before calibration, can we move their review to the next week without triggering 'defer'?
marta_peopleops: Yes 12 file an exception (short extension) and indicate local holiday. That counts as a focused extension not a defer. Please include coverage notes.
hiro_manager: final Q: deadlines 12 are there separate cutoffs for local-deadline vs system timestamp?
marta_peopleops: System timestamps remain the canonical cutoff for trackers, but if you've set a local-deadline in the form and filed an exception, we honor that for your org and will mark it in the tracker. If in doubt, ping us and we'll confirm.
lee_sre: thanks, will ping comp-ops when needed.
marta_peopleops: Thanks team 12 please update forms for any cross-border cases by EOD this week so calibration planners can slot appropriately.
